Package com.sandy.sconsole.ai.config

Record Class ModelInfo

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.sandy.sconsole.ai.config.ModelInfo
Record Components:
id - the model id sent to the gateway
gateway - the gateway hosting it
displayName - the name to show it by; null to show the id
enabledGlobally - its switch in the global config
enabledInApp - its switch in the app config
contextTokens - the context window to ask for (Ollama's num_ctx); null for the server's default
providerRateLimit - the provider's limits on this model
appRateLimit - the app's own limits on this model
maxParallel - the app's requests in flight on it at most
requestTimeout - the longest a whole request may take
retries - the attempts a job gets on it after a failed one, before following its fallback
reasoning - let it reason before answering
promptCaching - mark the prompt cacheable where the model supports it
fallback - where a job goes after it fails the job for good
public record ModelInfo(String id, GatewayInfo gateway, String displayName, boolean enabledGlobally, boolean enabledInApp, Integer contextTokens, RateLimit providerRateLimit, RateLimit appRateLimit, int maxParallel, Duration requestTimeout, int retries, boolean reasoning, boolean promptCaching, FallbackInfo fallback) extends Record
A model as an app uses it: the global definition (where it is hosted, the provider's limits) merged with the app's policy for it.
